title: Repair full-day hourly provider normalization for FT-003

Inspect Weather Context → Yandex Weather Adapter and Forecast Sessions → Weather Context against the registered Boundary Map and Capability Interfaces; no raw-provider or private-storage bypass is permitted and the existing eight-slot public projection remains unchanged.
